Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Imagine stepping into a world where sharp intellect meets high-stakes decision-making, and where every lesson is wrapped in stories of resilience, wit, and genuine wisdom. Together, we're about to explore the remarkable journey of Charlie Munger, whose life and philosophy come alive in Janet Lowe's engaging book, Damn Right!
What if you could discover the secrets behind unconventional thinking, and learn how a blend of curiosity, skepticism, and integrity can shape not just fortunes—but character? Munger’s partnership with Warren Buffett at Berkshire Hathaway is a powerful reminder of what happens when clear thinking, patience, and the courage to question the status quo all come together.
As we go along, you'll get a behind-the-scenes look at the moments that shaped Munger’s unique worldview—from personal setbacks to hard-won triumphs. We’ll unpack the mental models, ethical frameworks, and guiding principles that inform his decisions—not just in investing, but in everyday life.
So, if you’re curious about what it really takes to build lasting success and wisdom, you’re in the right place. Let’s set off on this journey together and see what it truly means to think damn right.
